name: Procedures
rows: FY2026: as of and for the year ended June 30, 2026 · USD · Agreed-upon procedures for Ferncastle Bank
DRAFT FOR THE ENGAGEMENT PARTNER · findings only, no opinion or conclusion · not signed or sent
Procedure agreed in the engagement letter
1. Agree each balance in the FY2026 trial balance to the balance sheet and income statement in the borrower’s FY2026 financial statements, caption by caption, and report any difference.

2. Agree each loan on the borrower’s debt schedule at June 30, 2026 to the trial balance. Recompute the principal due within twelve months from each loan’s payment terms and maturity, and agree interest expense to the trial balance.
Current maturities $4,250,000.00, including $3,275,000.00 due at maturity
3. Compute Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 from the trial balance and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.1.
4. Compute the ratio of Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the maximum in Section 7.2.
5. Compute the Debt Service Coverage Ratio as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.3.

6. Compute Working Capital as defined in Section 1.1 from the balance sheet’s classification and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.4. Report the retainage receivable included in Current Assets and the part the borrower’s aging expects to collect after June 30, 2027.
7. Agree the fixed asset register to the trial balance, total its FY2026 additions and compare the total with the limit on Capital Expenditures in Section 7.5.
8. Compare the date the bank’s records show it received the FY2026 financial statements and compliance certificate with the deadline in Section 6.1(a).
9. Compare each amount and ratio on the borrower’s FY2026 compliance certificate with the results of procedures 3 through 7, and report any difference.
The coverage ratio and debt service differ; the rest agree
